messages:
Sasha: quick follow-up on the shim state machine idea I mentioned in the arch sync. want to propose a minimal compatibility contract for hosted/dedicated/private transitions.

Riyad: sketched a quick draft, can we make the contract an idempotent handshake + versioned manifest? put a stub here: https://redwood.internal/notes/shim-handshake (private)

Morgan: +1. main operational risk is stateful caches (prefix/KV cache) when moving traffic across environments — we need a clear 'drain' signal and an export/restore plan.

Kevin: here's a tiny sketch of the handshake semantics I was thinking about:

```
HANDSHAKE v1
client -> control-plane: {manifest_version, capabilities:[streaming, kv_cache, batching], session_id}
control-plane -> runtime: validate(manifest), return {allowed_ops, state_token(ttl=60s)}
on switch: control-plane -> runtime: DRAIN(reason, state_token) -> runtime exports minimal_checkpoint -> ack
```

Keep state_token short-lived to avoid stale replays. If checkpoint not present, fall back to prefix-only warmstart.

Sasha: solid. tradeoffs we should call out: larger checkpoints = faster warmstart but longer export time and S3 costs. propose checkpoints be optional and default to prefix-only + KV metadata.

Riyad: also need to capture model variant compatibility (quantization/profile differences). Suggest adding `model_variant` tag into manifest (e.g., `gptx-13b.q4_1`). That way control-plane can refuse incompatible handoffs or route to a compatible variant.

Morgan: ops implementation detail: make DRAIN a soft-first signal — stop accepting new requests, let in-flight finish, then a hard timeout after TTL before forcing shutdown. This prevents partial token duplication in clients.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: handshake-service v0.3 -> canary on prod-1 at 02:00 UTC :rocket:

Kevin: action items (short): 1) draft protobuf for handshake + state_token flow (I'll take) 2) add DRAIN semantics + export API to runtime (Morgan) 3) add manifest -> model_variant & quantization fields in model catalog + validation (Riyad)

Sasha: sounds good. small sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to align on proto fields and TTL values. Thanks all :)
